name: What is the advantage of using a single contractor for framing, drywall, and painting?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of using a single contractor for framing, drywall, and painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor who handles framing, drywall, and finish carpentry prevents miscommunication between separate trades. When one crew handles structural framing and wall finish, they ensure studs are plumb and aligned before hanging board, eliminating bowed walls and uneven seams later. It also speeds up the project schedule, as the same team moves directly from hanging and mudding into installing baseboards, crown molding, doors, and interior paint without waiting for multiple independent sub-contractors to fit you into their schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single contractor ensures proper framing alignment before drywall goes up, eliminates delays between trades, and streamlines the process through final trim and painting.
